Original list inheritance probes generated by `tools/list_style_indent_fixture.py`, exported with the reference application. No third-party document content. The reference records marker, first-line text and continuation positions from all 24 cases across three pages. PDF text coordinates have approximately 0.05 pt rounding. Ancestor indents are overridden by numbering; declarations on the nearest style supplying numId and its descendants override numbering. Direct numbering follows all styles; direct paragraph indents win last. Cases include explicit zeros, repeated numId, Normal ancestry, first-line/hanging conflicts and left indents. Source and PDF hashes are in reference.json.
